findings.body: Raise: Functional. A board or `forge next` read can show an obsolete review round or clean readiness for up to 60 seconds after another teammate updates the PR. The new `body` field is stored in `_machine_prs`'s 60-second cache (lines 94–102). In `machine_board`, that cached PR takes precedence over the fresh open-PR list because `setdefault` does not replace it (lines 240–248); `nextstep._report` likewise overwrites fresh PR data with the cached result (lines 191–195). A normal close or push during that minute therefore leaves another machine reading the old shared record or head despite its fetch.
findings.title: Not done: teammates see the current PR time record
